# Design — Paper Trail

Locked design system. Later runs read this file first and defer to it. Amend
intentionally — the file is the rule, not a note.

## System
- Kind · docs site for internal engineers
- Genre · editorial
- Axes · cool grey paper / transitional serif / one moss hue
- Anchor · a 1952 Penguin Special · counter-anchor · the same, no software reference
- Dark mode · light only


## Design Read
> Reading this as: `docs site` for `internal engineers`, in an `editorial` language, dial `2/3/1`.

- Differentiator · rules and a hanging number column instead of cards, so a page of prose still scans like a manual

Dial: ENERGY 2 / RHYTHM 3 / MOTION 1
Status: locked


## Tokens
```css
:root {
  --color-paper:      oklch(0.98 0.004 250);
  --color-paper-2:    oklch(0.95 0.006 250);
  --color-ink:        oklch(0.26 0.012 250);
  --color-ink-2:      oklch(0.48 0.014 250);
  --color-rule:       oklch(0.26 0.012 250 / 0.12);
  --color-accent:     oklch(0.42 0.07 155);
  --color-accent-ink: oklch(0.98 0.004 250);
  --color-focus:      oklch(0.42 0.07 155);

  --font-display: "Spectral", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif;
  --font-body:    "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono:    "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;

  --space-2xs: 4px;  --space-xs: 8px;  --space-s: 12px;  --space-m: 24px;
  --space-l: 40px;   --space-xl: 64px; --space-2xl: 104px;

  --text-xs: 12px;  --text-s: 14px;  --text-base: 16px;
  --text-l: 20px;   --text-xl: 25px; --text-2xl: 31px;  --text-display: 48px;

  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --dur-fast: 180ms;  --dur-base: 240ms;  --dur-slow: 320ms;

  --radius-card: 2px;  --radius-pill: 999px;  --radius-input: 2px;

```


## Type
- Display · `Spectral` · page titles and h2 · 2 weights
- Body · `Inter` · 2 weights · budget 2 font files
- Fallback logic · system stack renders first, Spectral swaps in

## Layout
- Grid · single column, 72ch measure, sidebar only above 1100px
- Measure · 72ch
- Section rhythm · --space-l between sections, --space-m inside
- Focal rule · exactly one focal point per screen; everything else defers

## Components
- Card · none — hairline rules and whitespace
- Primary control · fill --color-accent · --radius-input · 10px 16px
- Secondary control · 1px outline in --color-rule, never filled
- Divider · 1px --color-rule, full measure
- Focus · 2px --color-focus, 2px offset

## Motion
- Stance · 1-2 reveal primitives
- Primitives · opacity plus 8px rise on first paint only
- Reduced-motion · ≤150 ms opacity crossfade, no transform

## Decisions
- **color** · cool grey paper keeps code blocks readable next to prose
- **type** · a transitional serif gives long-form pages a voice without a display face
- **layout** · one column, because reading is the only job here
- **spacing** · four steps, section gaps doubled, so headings do the separating
- **radius** · 2px reads as printed paper; pill radius stays on tags only
- **motion** · one reveal on first paint; docs are read, not performed
- **accent** · one moss hue pulled from the logo, never two on a screen


## Do's and Don'ts
- gradient-free deliberately — hairline rules carry the structure

- never: a second accent hue on one screen
